# Tour Helpdesk

> TourHelpDesk (https://tourhelpdesk.com) is an online travel booking platform and 24/7 travel concierge service providing real-time price comparisons across 500+ global airlines, luxury hotel reservations, and intercity bus routes. We specialize in published and unpublished offline consolidated flight fares with 24/7 phone assistance.

## Quick Facts
- **Website**: https://tourhelpdesk.com
- **24/7 Phone Concierge**: +1 (888) 791-8007 (Toll-Free, 24/7 Booking Desk)
- **Customer Support Email**: support@tourhelpdeskinc.com
- **Currencies Accepted**: USD, CAD, INR, EUR, GBP, AED
- **Payment Methods**: Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover, Net Banking, UPI
- **Primary Markets**: United States, Canada, India, United Kingdom, UAE, International

## Core Services

### 1. Flights & Cheap Airfare
- Live search and booking across 500+ domestic and international airlines (Delta, American Airlines, United, Air Canada, British Airways, Emirates, Qatar Airways, IndiGo, Air India, and more).
- Unpublished offline phone-only fares available via 24/7 Booking Desk (+1 888 791-8007).
- Flexible date searches, multi-city itineraries, one-way and round-trip bookings.
- Cabin classes: Economy, Premium Economy, Business Class, First Class.
- Dedicated page: https://tourhelpdesk.com/cheap-flights

### 2. Hotel Accommodations
- Worldwide hotel and resort booking with instant confirmation.
- Transparent room rates with no hidden amenity or resort surcharges.
- Flexible cancellation policies on participating properties.
- Dedicated page: https://tourhelpdesk.com/hotels

### 3. Bus & Ground Transportation
- Intercity bus ticket booking across major domestic transit networks.
- Clean seating, sleeper, and luxury coach options.
- Dedicated page: https://tourhelpdesk.com/bus

### 4. 24/7 AI Travel Assistant & Human Concierge
- Live AI Travel Concierge on website for instant itinerary recommendations and flight comparisons.
- Offline travel desk for complex multi-city bookings, group travel, baggage add-ons, and special assistance (wheelchair, special meals).

## Booking Policy & Traveler Guarantees
- **Best Price Commitment**: Real-time fare tracking ensures travelers receive competitive market rates.
- **24/7 Live Assistance**: Dedicated phone agents available at +1 (888) 791-8007 for flight changes, cancellations, and rebooking.
- **Data Privacy & Security**: 256-bit SSL encrypted transactions; PCI-DSS compliant payment processing.
- **IATA Partner Network**: Bookings are facilitated through accredited ARC and IATA travel partners.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is TourHelpDesk?
TourHelpDesk is a comprehensive travel booking engine and concierge service helping travelers find, compare, and book the cheapest available flights, hotels, and bus tickets worldwide.

### How do I get unpublished offline flight discounts?
Call our 24/7 Phone Help Desk at +1 (888) 791-8007. Airline aggregators often allocate special phone-only consolidated fares that cannot be published online due to airline fare rules.

### How can I modify or cancel my booking?
You can manage your reservation by calling our 24/7 desk at +1 (888) 791-8007 or emailing support@tourhelpdeskinc.com with your Booking Request ID.

### Are my payment details safe?
Yes. All payments are processed through bank-grade 256-bit SSL encryption adhering to strict PCI-DSS security standards.
